# Fetch all songs in Spotify song library (paginated)

def fetch_all_song_library(access_token, page_limit=20):
    all_songs=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        all_songs.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
    return all_songs

songs_library = fetch_all_song_library(access_token)
print('library_song_count', len(songs_library))
print('library_song_ids_sample', [s['song_id'] for s in songs_library[:10]])
print('library_added_at_sample', [s['added_at'] for s in songs_library[:3]])

# Fetch all playlists in playlist library (paginated)

def fetch_all_playlists(access_token, page_limit=20, is_public=None):
    all_playlists=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, is_public=is_public)
        if not resp:
            break
        all_playlists.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
    return all_playlists

playlists_all = fetch_all_playlists(access_token)
print('playlists_count', len(playlists_all))
print('playlists_sample', [(p['playlist_id'], p['title'], len(p.get('song_ids',[]))) for p in playlists_all[:5]])
# also check for paging completeness by showing max/min song_ids length
print('song_ids_total', sum(len(p.get('song_ids',[])) for p in playlists_all))

from datetime import datetime

# Use previously fetched data: songs_library, playlists_all, access_token

# Collect unique song IDs from library and playlists
library_song_ids = sorted({s['song_id'] for s in songs_library})
playlist_song_ids = sorted({sid for p in playlists_all for sid in p.get('song_ids',[])})
unique_song_ids = sorted(set(library_song_ids) | set(playlist_song_ids))
print('library_song_ids_count', len(library_song_ids))
print('playlist_song_ids_count', len(playlist_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids_count', len(unique_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids', unique_song_ids)

# Fetch release_date for each unique song id
release_map = {}
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_map[sid] = song.get('release_date')

# Show sample mapping
items = list(release_map.items())
items_sorted = sorted(items, key=lambda x: x[0])
print('release_map_sample', items_sorted[:10])

# Determine which are released before 2021-01-01
cutoff = datetime(2021,1,1)
pre2021_song_ids = []
for sid, rd in release_map.items():
    # rd could be None; handle
    if not rd:
        continue
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(rd.replace('Z','+00:00')) if 'T' in rd else datetime.fromisoformat(rd)
    if dt < cutoff:
        pre2021_song_ids.append(sid)
pre2021_song_ids = sorted(pre2021_song_ids)
print('pre2021_song_ids_count', len(pre2021_song_ids))
print('pre2021_song_ids', pre2021_song_ids)

# Target removals from library
library_pre2021_song_ids = sorted(set(library_song_ids) & set(pre2021_song_ids))
print('library_pre2021_count', len(library_pre2021_song_ids))
print('library_pre2021_song_ids', library_pre2021_song_ids)

# Target removals from each playlist
playlist_targets = {}
for p in playlists_all:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    song_ids = p.get('song_ids',[])
    to_remove = sorted(set(song_ids) & set(pre2021_song_ids))
    if to_remove:
        playlist_targets[pid] = to_remove
print('playlist_targets_playlists_count', len(playlist_targets))
print('playlist_targets', playlist_targets)

# Total removals from playlists
playlist_removal_pairs = [(pid, sid) for pid, sids in playlist_targets.items() for sid in sids]
print('playlist_removal_pairs_count', len(playlist_removal_pairs))

# Verification after removals

# Check song library still contains any of the removed song ids
removed_library_ids=set([110,199,208,294,301])

# Fetch all songs in library again (paginated)

def fetch_all_song_library(access_token, page_limit=20):
    all_songs=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        all_songs.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
    return all_songs

songs_library_after = fetch_all_song_library(access_token)
after_library_ids=set(s['song_id'] for s in songs_library_after)
still_present_library = sorted(removed_library_ids & after_library_ids)
print('library_removed_ids_still_present', still_present_library)

# Check each playlist removed songs no longer present
playlist_targets = {195: [97, 159], 194: [143], 193: [112], 192: [223, 290], 196: [163, 225, 248]}

# Fetch playlists again

def fetch_all_playlists(access_token, page_limit=20, is_public=None):
    all_playlists=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        kwargs={'access_token':access_token,'page_index':page_index,'page_limit':page_limit}
        if is_public is not None:
            kwargs['is_public']=is_public
        resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(**kwargs)
        if not resp:
            break
        all_playlists.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
    return all_playlists

playlists_after = fetch_all_playlists(access_token)

# Build map playlist_id -> song_ids
map_after={p['playlist_id']: set(p.get('song_ids',[])) for p in playlists_after}

still_present_playlist={}
for pid, sids in playlist_targets.items():
    present = sorted(set(sids) & map_after.get(pid,set()))
    if present:
        still_present_playlist[pid]=present

print('playlist_removed_ids_still_present', still_present_playlist)

# Also print current counts
print('library_song_count_after', len(songs_library_after))
print('total_playlist_song_ids_after', sum(len(p.get('song_ids',[])) for p in playlists_after))

# Mark task complete
resp = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print(resp)
